attacker_monitors_mempool_occurred.meaning: attacker observes the protocol's liquidity-addition transaction in the public mempool before it executes

liquidity_addition_pending.meaning: protocol has submitted an increaseLiquidityCurrentRange liquidity addition to the pool that has not yet executed

attacker_profit_captured.meaning: value extracted from the protocol by the sandwich manipulation is captured as profit by the MEV bot

protocol_received_fair_liquidity_value.meaning: protocol receives liquidity value corresponding to the assets it provided, at a rate not manipulable by surrounding pool-price changes

assumptions: The liquidity addition is a protocol-initiated transaction observable in the public mempool before execution.
The pool price surrounding the liquidity addition is manipulable by an external actor.
The report describes the attack as potential rather than a concrete observed transaction.

unresolved.description: Report does not quantify the unfavorable rate, the extracted value, or the liquidity shortfall, so the value relation is bound at the qualitative outcome level.
Report does not state who may call increaseLiquidityCurrentRange or any authorization condition; no access-control qualifier is formalized.

limitations: Value relation is expressed with grounded Boolean observables because the report supplies no numeric rate or amount operands.
Only the attacker_profit impact is formalized; other reported impacts are handled in separate passes.
No concrete sandwich transaction is established; the scenario is potential.
